subject.title: iOS app: push notifications for assistant messages + background Talk mode

question: Should native iOS assistant-message notifications use generic lock-screen content by default, allow transcript previews only behind explicit opt-in, or remain unsupported until a broader mobile notification privacy model is approved?
rationale: The APNs registration, relay, local notification, and exec-approval push primitives exist, but payload content, relay exposure, lock-screen privacy, tap routing, duplicate foreground behavior, and per-device opt-in semantics require maintainer security/product intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve Generic Chat Alerts First
options.body: Add a dedicated chat-reply APNs kind and iOS tap route with generic notification content by default, leaving transcript previews for a later explicit opt-in.

options.title: Allow Opt-In Transcript Previews
options.body: Permit assistant reply text in APNs only behind a visible per-device or per-gateway privacy setting with tests and docs for lock-screen behavior.

options.title: Defer native chat pushes
options.body: Keep relying on foreground app state and third-party channels until maintainers define a broader mobile notification policy.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Chat Alerts First
recommendation.body: Add a dedicated chat-reply APNs kind and iOS tap route with generic notification content by default, leaving transcript previews for a later explicit opt-in.
